INSTITUTIONAL · PRACTICAL TRAINING

Hands-on Workshops

Foundational, practice-oriented training in single-cell and spatial omics analysis. Workshops combine essential concepts with guided analysis of curated datasets.

Discuss a workshop ↗Explore learning pathways →

CURRENT TRAINING TOPICS

Foundational omics workshops

01

Basic scRNA-seq data analysis

Explore single-cell expression data, quality control, clustering, cell annotation, and interpretation.

02

Basic scATAC-seq data analysis

Introduction to chromatin accessibility analysis and regulatory signals at single-cell resolution.

03

scRNA-seq + scATAC-seq integration

Foundational approaches to connect gene expression and chromatin accessibility.

04

Basic spatial transcriptomics

Introduction to spatial gene-expression data, tissue organization, and spatial interpretation.

Workshop scope, schedule, and delivery format are discussed according to institutional needs.
